entries.title: Chapter 0-00 | Prelude
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story begins! Let's all enjoy a wonderfully opening cinematic!

entries.title: Chapter 0-01 | Taking on the Town
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! We explore and chat with all the lovely (and kinda sketchy) folks of the town!

entries.title: Chapter 0-02 | Unfurl with Passion!
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! We finally make our way to the Thousand-Year Door and unfurl the magically map... with passion!

entries.title: Chapter 1-01 | Castle and Dragon
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! We begin chapter 1 and our journeys in Petal Meadows!

entries.title: Chapter 1-02 | Who Wants to be a Shhwonk?
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! We continue to Shhwonk Fortress and star in a game show!

entries.title: Chapter 1-03 | Music Turmoil
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! We enter Hooktail Castle and I have some inner turmoil over the music...

entries.title: Chapter 1-04 | Dragon Destiny
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! We reach the end of Hooktail Castle and meet our dragon destiny!

entries.title: Chapter 1-05 | Voice Actor in Training
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we witness much dialog and put my voice acting to the test!

entries.title: Chapter 1-06 | Town Touch-ups
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we tend to  the various events that have become available to us back in Rogueport!

entries.title: Chapter 1-07 | West Side Story
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we tackle the fancy west side of Rogueport and prepare for our pit of 100 trials run!

entries.title: Chapter 1-08 | Pit of Tragedy
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we take on the first 30 floors of the Pit of 100 Trials... and it ends in tragedy.

entries.title: Chapter 1-09 | Pit of Victory
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we take on the first 30 floors of the Pit of 100 Trials for a second time, while learning from the mistakes we made last time!

entries.title: Chapter 1-10 | Think Again Nerd!
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we wrap up the last preparations before heading to chapter 2!

entries.title: Chapter 2-01 | The Great Boggly Tree
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we finally begin the long awaited chapter 2!

entries.title: Chapter 2-02 | Backtrack Woods
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we backtrack a lot trough the woods to wherever the story requires!

entries.title: Chapter 2-03 | A Small Army
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we continue the Great Boggly Tree and recruit a small army!

entries.title: Chapter 2-04 | Punies of Rohirrim
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we continue the Great Boggly Tree and grow our army even more!

entries.title: Chapter 2-05 | Buried in Canada
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we finish the Boggly tree and get what we came for!

entries.title: Chapter 2-06 | Dancing On My Own
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we tackle the Chapter 2 intermission segments!

entries.title: Chapter 2-07 | Stories and Star Pieces
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we hunt for a few outstanding star pieces and hear the next chapter in Luigi's story!

entries.title: Chapter 2-08 | Piantas in Crime
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we meet with the Pianta syndicate and obtain the tickets needed to head to Glitzville!

entries.title: Chapter 3-01 | Of Glitz and Glory
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we finally start chapter 3 and see what Glitzville has to offer!

entries.title: Chapter 3-02 | King of the Pit
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we climb the ranks of the minor league in the Glitz Pit!

entries.title: Chapter 3-03 | Breaking into Major
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we challenge the notorious Iron Twins to break our way into the major league!

entries.title: Chapter 3-04 | Glitz Pit Stop
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we make a brief pit stop back to Rogueport and see what our new Yoshi friend unlocks!

entries.title: Chapter 3-05 | A Major Debut
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we start the climb in the major league and finally receive a hammer upgrade!

entries.title: Chapter 3-06 | An Unexpected Intermission
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we continue through the major league and fight some unexpected foes!

entries.title: Chapter 3-07 | Fight to the Finish
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we finish climbing through the major league as we aim for the top spot!

entries.title: Chapter 3-08 | Rawking the Hawk
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we at long last take on the champion of the Glitz Pit, Rawk Hawk!

entries.title: Chapter 3-09 | The TRUE Champion
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we put an end to the Glitz Pit conspiracy once and for all with a battle to the finish with Macho Grubba!

entries.title: Chapter 3-10 | Mission Possible
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we tackle the chapter 3 intermission segments; where Peach's role starts to get interesting!

entries.title: Chapter 3-11 | Stories and Shady Investments
entries.description: Our Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door story continues! Today we head back to Rogueport and catch up with our favourite characters before we embark for chapter 4!

entries.title: Chapter 4-01 | For Pigs the Bell Tolls
entries.description: Today we start the well remembered chapter 4! Let's see how the remake has changed things around here...

entries.title: Chapter 4-02 | Creepy But Cool
entries.description: Today we embark for the Creepy Steeple and encounter some concerningly strong enemies along the way...

entries.title: Chapter 4-03 | Man of Mystery
entries.description: Today we make our way through the Creepy Steeple and face off against the monster of the tower!

entries.title: Chapter 4-04 | Identity Fraud
entries.description: Today we track down the ghost who stole our identity!

entries.title: Chapter 4-05 | The Alphabet Bandit
entries.description: Today we discover the imposter's true name and attempt to take him down!

entries.title: Chapter 4-06 | TEC-nical Loopholes
entries.description: Today we tackle the chapter 4 intermission segments! The Peach story gets more interesting while Bowser goes for a swim!

entries.title: Chapter 4-07 | Stories and Spring Cleaning
entries.description: Today we head back to Rogueport and hear the next chapters in all our favourite stories! Oh, and some spring cleaning tasks here and there...

entries.title: Chapter 4-08 | The Great Mouse Bandit
entries.description: Today we tackle the mysterious trouble request and run into an old "friend"!

entries.title: Chapter 4-09 | The Cook Book Quest
entries.description: Today we tackle Zess T's cook book quest, which requires a return once more to the Creepy Steeple! It's all good though, because we missed a few things along the way...

entries.title: Chapter 4-10 | Pit Act II
entries.description: Today we make our second run through the Pit of 100 Trials! Let's just say, it goes much better than last time!

entries.title: Chapter 4-11 | Amazy Dayzee Grinding
entries.description: In this bonus episode, we attempt the amazy dayzee grinding strategy to obtain boat loads of experience rather quickly!

entries.title: Chapter 5-00 | A Wife's Tale
entries.description: Today we prepare to embark for Keelhaul Key! But first we need a helmsman, and it's a rather sad story...

entries.title: Chapter 5-01 | The Key to Pirates
entries.description: Today we set sail for Keelhaul Key, which doesn't quite go to plan...

entries.title: Chapter 5-02 | A Last Wish
entries.description: Today we set out to save Bobbery from the Embers we definitely could of stopped the first time...

entries.title: Chapter 5-03 | The Adventures of Flavio!!!
entries.description: Today we take Flavio on an adventure to Pirate Grotto! Although he just waits outside...

entries.title: Chapter 5-04 | Belly of the Beast
entries.description: Today we dive deeper into the Pirate's Grotto and challenge the Pirate King Cortez!

entries.title: Chapter 5-05 | Engines of War
entries.description: Today we make our escape from Keehaul Key with a little help from an new frenemy...

entries.title: Chapter 5-06 | Mission Invisible
entries.description: Today we tackle the Peach and Bowser intermission segments!

entries.title: Chapter 5-07 | Stories and Sailboats
entries.description: Today we return to Rogueport and catch up with our favourite story tellers! Oh, and also finally make use of all those boat panels we've seen around...

entries.title: Chapter 5-08 | The Opposite of Down
entries.description: Today we return to Hooktail Castle for a third on the request of Merlon's strange riddle...

entries.title: Chapter 6-00 | Mario meets Mafia
entries.description: Today we start our chapter 6 quest with a second meeting of the Pianta Mafia...

entries.title: Chapter 6-01 | Three Days of Excess
entries.description: Today we embark on out three day journey aboard the Excess Express! A fan favourite chapter!

entries.title: Chapter 6-02 | Unpaid Intern
entries.description: Today we start day two aboard the Excess Express! Looks like Pennington has a new mystery for us...

entries.title: Chapter 6-03 | Sunset on the Riverside
entries.description: Today we explore the strangely mysterious Riverside station and see if we can get the train moving again!

entries.title: Chapter 6-04 | Smorgs on a Train
entries.description: Today we wake to find the train strangely empty... Guess it time to do what all good train stories do; have a climax on the roof of a speeding train!

entries.title: Chapter 6-05 | Sanctum of Secrets
entries.description: Today we wake finally arrive in Poshley Heights and make our way to the Sanctum. Once inside, there may be more than meets the eye...

entries.title: Chapter 6-06 | Love and Warriors
entries.description: Today we tackle the chapter 6 intermission segments! Peach is in some real trouble, while Bowser duels with a classic foe!

entries.title: Chapter 6-07 | Stories and Side Quests (part 1)
entries.description: Today we catch up with (some of) our favourite story tellers and take care of some odd quests 'round Rogueport!

entries.title: Chapter 6-08 | Stories and Side Quests (part 2)
entries.description: Today we catch up with (the rest of) our favourite story tellers and some new ones! Oh, and some more odd quests 'round Rogueport and beyond!

entries.title: Chapter 6-09 | The CURSED Olympics
entries.description: Today we tackle the Pianta Parlor mini-games based around the four curses: The Plane Game, The Paper Game, The Tube Game, and The Boat Game!

entries.title: Chapter 6-10 | Pit Act III - The Old Stuff
entries.description: Today we begin our third (and final?) descent into the pit! But first, we have to grind through the old stuff...

entries.title: Chapter 6-11 | Pit Act III - The New Stuff
entries.description: Today we continue our descent into the pit! And it's getting pretty dangerous down here...

entries.title: Chapter 6-12 | Pit Act III - The Hard Stuff
entries.description: Today we complete our descent into the pit! We're so close now; just one last stretch of challenges to go...

entries.title: Chapter 7-01 | Mario Shoots the Moon
entries.description: Today we begin the long awaited chapter seven and embark on our quest for the final Crystal Star!

entries.title: Chapter 7-02 | Evil Incarnate
entries.description: Today we hunt down the missing bob-omb generals needed to relaunch the cannon project! And one of them is a little trickier than that other...

entries.title: Chapter 7-03 | One Small Step for Mario
entries.description: Today we make our way to the moon and explore! Turns out this place is pretty big; go figure...

entries.title: Chapter 7-04 | Storming the Fortress
entries.description: Today we storm the X-Naut Fortress and see just what puzzles lie within...

entries.title: Chapter 7-05 | Man in the Moon
entries.description: Today we blast through the last area of the fortress and take on the boss! Hey, we know you...

entries.title: Chapter 7-06 | Goodbyes
entries.description: Today we tackle the chapter 7 intermission segments! No peach this time, but Mario's gets a little sad...

entries.title: Chapter 7-07 | Stories and Sappy Endings
entries.description: Today we catch up with our favourite story tellers and hear the ends to their many tales!

entries.title: Chapter 8-01 | Beyond the Thousand-Year Door
entries.description: Today we at long, long last open the Thousand-Year Door and see what mysteries lie beyond...

entries.title: Chapter 8-02 | Familiar Foes
entries.description: Today we explore the strange underground city, and encounter a familiar, yet not so familiar foe...

entries.title: Chapter 8-03 | Palace of Puzzles
entries.description: Today we explore the strange tower which is full of even stranger puzzles... Oh, then a boss fight I suppose!

entries.title: Chapter 8-04 | Homestretch
entries.description: Today we tackle the final stretch of the Palace of Shadow! Using almost every ability at our disposal, it does not disappoint!

entries.title: Chapter 8-05 | Boss Bros.
entries.description: Today we take on Grodus once and for all! Oh, and I guess Bowser shows up too...

entries.title: Chapter 8-06 | Queen of the Climax
entries.description: Today we take on the final boss of the game! It's been a long road, and this battle is certainly no pushover!

entries.title: Chapter 8-07 | Victory Lap
entries.description: After returning to Rogueport, we travel around the world seeing all the new changes! And let's find those star pieces and badges we missed along the way...

entries.title: Chapter 8-08 | Community Service
entries.description: Today we tackle every last remaining trouble in the trouble center! Some are interesting, some are strange, and some kinda just suck...

entries.title: Chapter 8-09 | Iron Chef Challenge
entries.description: Today we cook every recipe Zess T. has to offer! We're gonna need a lot of ingredients, so it's a good thing we're rich!

entries.title: Chapter 8-10 | Whacka's Revenge
entries.description: Today we take on the first of the new secret bosses in this remake! Down down in the dungeon below lies one who awaits his revenge...

entries.title: Chapter 8-11 | Remember the Champions
entries.description: Today we conclude our adventure by reclaiming our champion rank in Glitz Pit and taking on the true champion of champions: Prince Mush!
